The '''Bendeluum system''' was in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], part of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the planet [[Bendeluum/Legends|Bendeluum]].
